title: WipEout Omega Collection (wipeout_pc)
description: WipEout Omega Collection (PS4) native PC port for Windows: the game's own x86-64 code on the CPU, a PS4 runtime and the shadPS4 Vulkan video core. Playable, in active development. No game files included. ⭐ Star it if you like it; bug reports and requests are welcome in Issues!
